name: Chocolate Chip Cookies
source: Adapted from the classic Toll House formula (grams)
steps: Heat the oven to 190C/375F. Whisk flour, baking soda and salt.
Cream the softened butter with both sugars until light, 2-3 min.
Beat in the eggs and vanilla.
Mix in the dry ingredients until just combined, then fold in the chips.
Scoop tablespoons onto lined trays, spaced apart.
Bake 9-11 min until the edges are golden but centres look soft.
Cool on the tray 5 min, then transfer to a rack.
notes: Makes about 36. Chill the dough 30 min for thicker cookies. Scale by servings for a bigger batch.
